entries.name: Parse State Queue__jki_lib_state_machine
entries.description: JKI State Machine: takes the first state off State Queue. Blank lines and text after //, # or /* on a line are skipped, and the state is split at >> into Current State and Arguments. An error in gives the state Error Handler.
entries.python_code:
{remaining_states} = {state_queue}
{current_state} = ''
{arguments} = ''
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    {current_state} = 'Error Handler'
elif {state_queue} != '':
    _queue = {state_queue}
    while True:
        _end = re.search('[\r\n]+', _queue)
        _line = _queue if _end is None else _queue[:_end.start()]
        _rest = '' if _end is None else _queue[_end.end():]
        _comment = min([len(_line)] + [_at for _at in (_line.find('//'), _line.find('#'), _line.find('/*')) if _at >= 0])
        _text = _line[:_comment].lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t')
        _queue = _rest.lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t\r\n')
        _split = re.search('[ \t]*>>[ \t]*', _text)
        _state = _text if _split is None else _text[:_split.start()]
        _arguments = '' if _split is None else _text[_split.end():]
        if _queue == '' or _state != '':
            break
    {remaining_states} = _queue
    {current_state} = _state
    {arguments} = _arguments
